mechanism: Penicillin-class allergy: cross-reactive beta-lactam antibiotics may trigger IgE-mediated hypersensitivity, urticaria, or anaphylaxis.
Sulfonamide allergy: risk of hypersensitivity reactions including Stevens-Johnson syndrome in sensitized patients.
NSAID hypersensitivity: risk of bronchospasm (aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease) or urticaria in sensitized patients.
Cephalosporin allergy: hypersensitivity risk; ~2% cross-reactivity with penicillin allergy.
